subscription.title: Subscriptions
subscription.empty: No subscriptions yet. Add one to start watching a feed for updates.
subscription.action.runNow.tooltip: Trigger a check for this subscription right now
subscription.runNow.firstRun.description: Initial fetch — every existing item was recorded as the baseline. Subsequent checks will report only NEW items, and downstream notifications/workflows will start firing then.
subscription.runNow.noChanges: {{name}}: no new items since last check
subscription.create.title: Add subscription
subscription.edit.title: Edit subscription
subscription.provider.exhentai.search.ur: Paste a search results page or your Watched feed URL.
subscription.provider.exhentai.gallery.u: Watch this gallery for page-count, tag or upload-time changes.
subscription.provider.pixiv.followLatest: Which works to watch in the feed of users you follow.
subscription.field.collection.descriptio: Where what it finds goes. Leave empty and one is made with this subscription's name.
subscription.provider.soulplus.search.ur: The board's thread list, as it appears in your browser's address bar.
subscription.provider.soulplus.search.ke: Comma-separated. Leave empty to take the whole board — which is a lot, on a busy one.
subscription.provider.soulplus.search.ma: New threads are on the first page. More pages only helps the first check.
Everything it lists becomes a member — including works you have never seen, which is the point.
subscription.provider.dlsite.circle.maxP: New releases are on the first page. A prolific circle needs more only on the first check.
subscription.provider.bangumi.subjectRel: Paste the subject's page, or type its id.
Leave empty to take every relation, which for a long-running franchise is a lot.
